$comment: Hand-curated rates for models whose provider API publishes no machine-readable price. Keyed by model key (`<provider>:<owner>/<name>`). Tier keys: `<resolution>`, `<resolution>:video_in` (Replicate's dearer video-input variant) or `*` (any resolution), all lower-case. Copy each rate from the `current_tiers` block on the model's public page (`source`), set `checked` to the day you did, and re-check before every release. A rate the provider's own API publishes (OpenRouter `pricing_skus`) always wins over an entry here.

replicate:bytedance/seedance-2.5.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run has a video input.

replicate:bytedance/seedance-2.0.note: Per second of output video; the dearer tier applies when the run has a video input.
